evidence.finding: C6 corresponds to node pair Z-A' in the eight-span path.

evidence.source: Pianta piano tipo / pianta copertura photographs
evidence.finding: Z-A' lies on/adjacent to the stair opening boundary; the stair is explicitly marked close to this node pair.
C6 is omitted from explicit TRATTO groups at G1, G2 and G3 while surrounding spans are named.
C3=T-U is also 1.20 m but is included in explicit central load groups; short span length alone does not explain the C6 omission.
Repeated omission at the same topological position is a special-condition signal under the recovered drafting grammar.

interpretation.statement: C6 = Z-A' is a special stair/opening-edge structural condition and must not inherit ordinary adjacent floor-load recipes automatically.
